description: Read and manage church events and families using Pushpay ChMS API v2.

pushpay_new_event_occurrence_trigger.description: Runs for each new event occurrence in Pushpay / Church Community Builder. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields event_id, occurrence, start, end, event.id, event.campus_id, event.name, event.description, event.start, event.end, event.setup, event.cleanup, event.room_ratio, event.attend_max_quantity, event.room_description, event.phone, event.recurs, event.recur_end_date, event.guest_counts.going, event.guest_counts.maybe, event.guest_counts.not_going, event.guest_counts.not_responded, event.guest_counts.requesting, event.address.name, event.address.street, event.address.city, event.address.state, event.address.zip, event.address.longitude, event.address.latitude, event.address.country_iso, event.address.carrier_route, event.images.thumbnail, event.images.medium, event.images.large, event.checkin.grouping_id, event.checkin.room_ratio, event.checkin.room_description, event.checkin.checkin_label_type, event.checkin.checkin_label_quantity, event.checkin.attend_max_quantity, event.checkin.checkin_type, event.checkin.announcement, event.checkin_label_type, event.checkin_label_quantity, event.group.id, event.group.name

pushpay_new_family_trigger.description: Runs for each new family in Pushpay / Church Community Builder. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, last_name, message, address.name, address.street, address.city, address.state, address.zip, address.longitude, address.latitude, address.country_iso, address.carrier_route, actions, messages, images.thumbnail, images.medium, images.large

pushpay_new_or_updated_event_occurrence_.description: Runs for each event occurrence added or changed in Pushpay / Church Community Builder. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields event_id, occurrence, start, end, event.id, event.campus_id, event.name, event.description, event.start, event.end, event.setup, event.cleanup, event.room_ratio, event.attend_max_quantity, event.room_description, event.phone, event.recurs, event.recur_end_date, event.guest_counts.going, event.guest_counts.maybe, event.guest_counts.not_going, event.guest_counts.not_responded, event.guest_counts.requesting, event.address.name, event.address.street, event.address.city, event.address.state, event.address.zip, event.address.longitude, event.address.latitude, event.address.country_iso, event.address.carrier_route, event.images.thumbnail, event.images.medium, event.images.large, event.checkin.grouping_id, event.checkin.room_ratio, event.checkin.room_description, event.checkin.checkin_label_type, event.checkin.checkin_label_quantity, event.checkin.attend_max_quantity, event.checkin.checkin_type, event.checkin.announcement, event.checkin_label_type, event.checkin_label_quantity, event.group.id, event.group.name

pushpay_new_or_updated_family_trigger.description: Runs for each family added or changed in Pushpay / Church Community Builder. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, last_name, message, address.name, address.street, address.city, address.state, address.zip, address.longitude, address.latitude, address.country_iso, address.carrier_route, actions, messages, images.thumbnail, images.medium, images.large
